errors: First Python decoder used one big int for the whole stream; each bit read shifted a multi-MB integer, and the G2 decode hit the 600 s timeout. Switched to an 8-byte window per read: 2.2 s.

Black level copied from the CR2 reader (median of the columns left of SensorInfo's picture) read 40-680 instead of 32-128 on the PowerShots: those columns are partly exposed. Fixed by reading SensorInfo's own masked rectangle (fields 9-12).
First drafts of the post and eval said 19 CIFF files on raw.pixls.us and 16 bodies; the count is 21 files and 15 bodies (16 model names: the Digital Rebel is the 300D). Corrected before commit.

doc_friction.issue: Several eval docs say raw.pixls.us answers 403 from this container; today it answered, and allocate.py's live probe said so. The probe line was right; the eval notes are stale history, worth not trusting.
The develop subcommand requires --out DIR rather than a positional destination; I guessed a positional path first. Minor.

notes: Routed ventures/2 by weighted draw; security queue empty; IDEAS.md and website requests empty. allocate.py picked photo-editing (row 5). Took the 'Coolpix NRW or Canon CRW reader' item: no public NRW sample, while raw.pixls.us held 21 CIFF CRWs. Built src/shootflow/crw.py (CIFF heap, Canon block Huffman coder with the three tree pairs, stored low bits, SensorInfo picture area and masked rectangle, three white-balance record families, ImageSpec rotation), wired into parse_raw, the profile chooser, raw_preview's developable list and the no-matrix refusal. tools/crw_libraw_check.py on 22 CIFF files (21 raw.pixls.us + the m-e-i 10D): 20 Bayer files from 15 bodies, 114,048,448 sensels, 0 differ; CFA equal on all; white balance equal on the 11 files that record one, none on the 9 that do not (LibRaw also has none); black within 2; G1 and Pro70 refused (CMYG). Exit 0. Develop end to end on 10D, G2, S60 with stand-in profiles: upright, clean pictures. Venture tests: run_venture_tests.py photo-editing -> ok, 1254 tests, 9 skipped, 141 s. Post checks: front matter clean, 0 broken links, 0 similar pairs. Open: EOS white level (4000 clip) unmeasured for lack of a clipped frame; real Adobe .dcp; D30 preset balance; NRW.
